scope: Compiled public consumers of generated package exports; internal Node behavior tests are separate unit-only coverage.

bounds.evidence: Exact qualification targets, not widened SDK peer claims. F03 established plain 5.40.0/current 5.57.3; F22 compiled both public matrices. F26 must separately qualify the Kit-declared 5.57.1 floor against final artifacts.
bounds.kit: Kit 3.1.0 declares Svelte ^5.57.1, plugin 7, Vite ^8.0.12 and TypeScript 6. Its lower qualification cell uses 5.57.1; plain 5.40.0 uses F03's Vite 7.1.4/plugin 6.2.1. Do not force incompatible Kit 5.40 peers.

prerequisites: Parent builds actual @shadergradient/core and @shadergradient/svelte generated exports once before qualification.
consumerRoot has installed @shadergradient/svelte and its real @shadergradient/core dependency, the selected exact peers, @types/three, TypeScript and svelte-check; no paths aliases.

For current workspace qualification, apps/example-svelte-dev is the default consumerRoot with an actual public native dependency. The SDK root's self-reference is not available inside a copied independent fixture package and is not a consumer substitute. Independent lower/current packed roots must install their own compiler/tooling.
No installs, SDK builds, application builds, preparation, formatters or browser/runtime checks run in this type runner.

configuration.skipLibCheck: Only dependency implementation declaration checking is skipped; all public component prop/callback/snippet assignments in consumers are checked.

flags.--consumer-root <path>: Installed compiler/package context with an actual native dependency; default apps/example-svelte-dev.
flags.--case <all|positive|negative-id>: Default all. Each negative runs as its own isolated Svelte project, not a combined expected-failure project.
flags.--expect-svelte <5.40.0|5.57.1|5.57.3>: Assert the selected actual compiler version; when omitted still requires one of the exact qualification targets. Target selection alone is not acceptance evidence.
flags.--artifact-id <identity>: Attach parent-provided native/core tarball identities or qualification label to the JSON evidence.
flags.--report <path>: Write full JSON including actual contexts, generated export resolution, fixture hashes, stdout/stderr and diagnostics; stdout also receives the report.
flags.--list: List fixture case IDs without invoking the compiler.

runner.cleanup: Only the unique mkdtemp subtree created inside consumerRoot is removed, in finally. Host app/config/manifests/node_modules/locks are never changed.
runner.packageResolution: Metadata and compiler resolution use Node ESM import.meta.resolve with --conditions=svelte in a child ESM eval anchored at the actual consumer or owner package directory, asserting that parent directory. The Svelte condition matches the fixture's real Bundler customConditions and supports Svelte-only public exports such as Threlte. Only an unexported package.json subpath falls back to the package's real conditional root export. Missing dependencies are failures. Native components are resolved, never bare-Node imported; no CJS/private-path aliases are introduced. Evidence retains each resolution URL, parent URL, ESM mode and custom conditions.
runner.diagnosticOracle: svelte-check machine-verbose TS source and numeric kind, intersecting the exact unique fixture expression line. Every diagnostic must be intended; dependency/config/import/other-line diagnostics fail, as do warnings or missing completion. Diagnostic wording is retained only as evidence, never matched.

verification: Authored edit-only. Parent must execute positive and every negative separately in both supported actual contexts, then rerun the same fixture matrix against identified installed tarballs. No acceptance is claimed by this manifest.
